shared_elements: animal in profile with four legs
low-relief carving on a stone surface
raised-line / outline relief rendering of forms
justification: Both show relief-carved animals in profile view on a stone face, which is about as generic a correspondence as one can have; A is dominated by dense horizontal registers of repeated small signs (a script-like inventory of birds, vessels, human-part and object glyphs) with a single large winged/feathered figure, while B shows only a couple of large isolated quadrupeds (a striding predator above, a longer creature below) with no register lines, no repeated sign system and no accompanying objects. The relationships and arrangements differ fundamentally: A is a densely packed, ruled, text-like grid, B is sparse isolated figures stacked on a tapering pillar-like slab.
